letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to call you my cutie. From the glittering skyline to the spice‑laden streets, our love feels like a warm hug that never fades. I cherish our shared laughter, the quiet evenings on the balcony, and the way your smile lights up even the hottest day. Here's to us, to the beautiful season we’re living in, and to countless more chapters together. I love you more than words can hold.
poem:
In Dubai’s gold we dance, in Ahmedabad’s rain we sigh,  
Your laugh’s the sweetest echo under every sky.  
Together we’re a story, written soft and bright,  
My heart beats “Liza” in every whispered night.
